clue.text: Met with certain changes making payment

indicators.note: changes tells us the letters of the two words get rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone met with certain changes to their terms when paying a bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' joins the two fodder words; 'making' links wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum of money sent to settle a bill is a synonym for a payment.

clue.text: Artist performs without heart and sings?

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

indicators.note: without heart drops the middle of performs, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: An artist performs half-heartedly and sings.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that rapping is only loosely singing.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhythmic rhyming speech over a beat is a kind of singing, hence the query.

clue.text: Crime's unravelled by Arnott oddly finding criminal

indicators.note: unravelled means the letters are untangled and put in another order
oddly takes the odd-placed letters of Arnott

explanation.surface: Arnott oddly finds a criminal by unravelling crimes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' gives ANT from Arnott, mixed with CRIMES.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer or villain is a synonym for a criminal.

clue.text: Slope takes time on hike

indicators.note: on means the time letter goes on top, before the slope in a down answer

parts.note: a ramp is a slope

explanation.surface: A slope takes a while to climb on a hike.
explanation.definitionFit: A long walk, often over rough country, is a hike.

clue.text: Vault this compiler has for old records

parts.note: an arch is a vault
the setter refers to themself as I
've, short for have, stands for has

explanation.surface: The setter keeps old records in a vault.
explanation.definitionFit: A collection of historic documents or a place storing them holds old records.

clue.text: Motor about to be put on ship's framework

parts.note: a motor is a car
CA, circa, means about
SS is steamship, with the 's joining it to framework

explanation.surface: A car engine about to be loaded onto a ship's frame.
explanation.definitionFit: The bare structure of a ship or building, its skeleton, is a framework.

clue.text: Destruction of atmosphere reversed

indicators.note: reversed says the word for atmosphere is read backwards

parts.note: the mood of a place is its atmosphere

explanation.surface: A disaster film line about the destruction of a planet's atmosphere being reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruin or destruction, as in a fate sealing one's downfall, is a synonym.

clue.text: Willow is comparatively blooming having been polled

indicators.note: polled means having had the head cut off, so the first letter goes

parts.note: rosier means more blooming, comparatively

explanation.surface: A willow said to be rosier for having been pollarded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'polled' suggests voting but means beheaded.
explanation.definitionFit: A type of willow whose pliable shoots are used in basketry.

clue.text: Judge artist performing in silly game

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged artist inside the rearranged game
silly means game is jumbled
performing means artist is reworked into new order

explanation.surface: A judge watching an artist perform in a silly game.
explanation.walkthrough: Both words are rearranged, and the scrambled artist sits inside the scrambled game, splitting it after its third letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A magistrate is a lay or minor judge in a local court.

clue.text: Old man's grateful expression seeing dish

parts.note: old man is father, PA; with the 's he becomes PA'S
TA is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: Dad says thanks on seeing what's been served for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is everyday British slang for 'thanks'.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian noodles such as spaghetti make a dish served at a meal.

clue.text: Concerned about sweetheart dressing down

indicators.note: about here means placed around the next piece, so the word for concerned goes round it

parts.note: concerned, as in solicitous, means caring
pet is an affectionate name for a sweetheart

explanation.surface: Someone worried about their loved one getting a telling-off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressing down' looks like clothing removal but means a scolding.
explanation.definitionFit: A severe reprimand is informally called this, as when a boss hauls someone over the coals.

clue.text: Guards missing first openings

indicators.note: missing first drops the opening letter

parts.note: sentries are guards

explanation.surface: The guards have left the first entrances unwatched.
explanation.definitionFit: Doorways or ways in are openings to a place.

clue.text: Copy of Queen record left around including single

parts.note: R stands for Regina, Latin for queen
an EP is an extended-play record
I, the Roman numeral one, stands for single
CA, short for circa, means around or about

explanation.surface: Seemingly about a copy of a Queen single on a record left lying around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen' and 'single' suggest the rock band and a hit, but give R and I.
explanation.definitionFit: An exact duplicate or reproduction of an original object is a copy.

clue.text: Birds giving performances for audience

indicators.note: for audience means the word is as heard by listeners, so its sound is what counts

parts.note: turns are acts or performances on a variety bill

explanation.surface: Birds putting on a show for watching spectators.
explanation.definitionFit: These are seabirds related to gulls, so an example of birds.

clue.text: Unruly gang rises accepting zero violence

indicators.note: accepting means the jumbled letters take the zero inside
unruly means the letters run wild into a new order

parts.note: O looks like zero

explanation.surface: An unruly gang rises up and gladly accepts violence.
explanation.walkthrough: The zero goes into the jumbled letters near the end, after the second S.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostile, attacking behaviour amounts to violence.

clue.text: Stone jar with popular content from the East

indicators.note: content, as in contained, puts the reversed piece inside the word for jar

parts.note: to jar is to grate, to jangle on the nerves

indicators.note: from the East means read right to left, the word for popular going backwards

parts.note: IN means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A stone jar holding something popular, imported from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jar' looks like a container but is the verb grate.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard igneous rock used for building and worktops is a type of stone.

clue.text: Some proclaim it a terrible copy

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people declare a copy terrible.
explanation.definitionFit: To mimic or reproduce someone's behaviour is to copy it.

clue.text: Snake is supple wearing skin of silver

indicators.note: wearing says the word for supple is dressed in the outer letters, sitting inside them
skin of means the outer letters of the next word

parts.note: lithe means supple, flexible

explanation.surface: A supple snake whose skin has a silvery sheen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snake' looks like a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To move with a sliding, sinuous motion is to snake along.

clue.text: Mother involved in hideous revolting 'domestic'

indicators.note: involved in means the mother piece sits inside
revolting means the letters of hideous rise up into a new order

parts.note: MA is mother

explanation.surface: A mother caught up in a hideous, revolting domestic row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'domestic' looks like a family quarrel but is a servant.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic is a household servant, such as a maid.

clue.text: Rougher sailor twisting knot faces resistance

indicators.note: faces means the knot piece sits in front of the resistance piece
twisting means the word for sailor turns round

parts.note: a tar is a sailor
a tie is a knot
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: A rough sailor twists a knot against resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Shabbier or more run-down, as in a scruffy coat, means rougher.

clue.text: Value securing help lifting beam

indicators.note: securing means the word for value holds the next piece inside

parts.note: to rate is to value

indicators.note: lifting means raised upward, so in a down answer the word for help reads bottom to top

parts.note: aid is help

explanation.surface: A valuer secures help to lift a heavy beam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beam' looks like timber but is the verb to shine.
explanation.definitionFit: To beam light is to send it out in rays from a source.

clue.text: Offensive, like sailor embracing superior

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: embracing says the word for sailor holds the next piece inside

parts.note: an old salt is a sailor
U means upper-class or superior

explanation.surface: An offensive remark, like a sailor hugging his superior officer.
explanation.walkthrough: U is a crossword convention for upper-class.
explanation.definitionFit: An offensive, as in a military push or attack, is a noun synonym.

clue.text: Neutral element deny Donald's holding back

indicators.note: back means those held letters read in reverse
holding says the letters are held inside these words

explanation.surface: A neutral element denies holding Donald back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding back' gives a reversed run of letters from 'deny Donald'.
explanation.definitionFit: Bland, inoffensive, unlikely to provoke: a neutral remark is of this kind.

clue.text: Space accommodating usually naked aficionados initially

definitions.text: Space accommodating usually naked aficionados initially

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of each of the five words before it

explanation.surface: A room where enthusiasts gather, mostly without clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue spells the answer in its initials and also describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot steam room is a space where bathers usually sit unclothed.

clue.text: Items from Sun, beginning to end about sex

indicators.note: about means the shifted word goes around the next piece
beginning to end moves the first letter of Sun to the back

parts.note: IT is slang for sex or sex appeal

explanation.surface: Stories from the Sun, front to back, all about sex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sun' looks like the British tabloid; 'beginning to end' gives UNS.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate items or single things counted in a collection are individual units.

clue.text: See old church is in decline

indicators.note: in places the old church piece inside the word for decline

parts.note: to die away is to decline
CE is the Church of England
is shortened to 's gives S

explanation.surface: Look: the old church is falling into decline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' seems a verb but is a bishop's district.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's see is the area under his jurisdiction, also called a diocese by synonym.

clue.text: Cancel Times before end of issue

indicators.note: before puts the times word ahead of the next letter

parts.note: eras are times or ages

indicators.note: end of takes the last letter of issue

explanation.surface: The Times cancels before the end of the issue goes to press.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper but means ages.
explanation.definitionFit: To wipe out or delete something is to cancel it.

clue.text: Periodically they arm squad

indicators.note: Periodically takes every other letter, starting from the first

explanation.surface: Every so often they arm a squad.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of players or workers acting together is a squad.

clue.text: One can time railway route

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a tin is a can
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: One person can time a railway journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A planned travel schedule sets out the route of a journey.

clue.text: Stone in front of arched door

indicators.note: front of takes the first letter of arched

parts.note: a gate is a door in a fence or wall

explanation.surface: A stone set before an arched doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: A banded variety of chalcedony is a semi-precious stone.

clue.text: Reportedly recognises smell

indicators.note: Reportedly says the word for recognises is taken as it is heard spoken

parts.note: knows means recognises

explanation.surface: Someone is said to recognise a smell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smell' is a verb here: to sniff out.
explanation.definitionFit: To sniff or detect by scent, as a dog does, is to smell.

clue.text: Vote about loud European split faces empty ultimatum

indicators.note: faces means the split piece sits in front of what follows

parts.note: RE means about or concerning
F is forte, the musical direction for loud
to rend is to split

indicators.note: empty removes the inside, leaving the first and last letters of ultimatum

explanation.surface: A vote on noisy European splits faces an ultimatum.
explanation.definitionFit: A national ballot on a single question is a vote put to the whole electorate.
